Name: (FEM) Claude's Emotes
Author: HeadInTheCloudsMods
Description:
[size=4][b]For mod users:
[/b][/size]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Spiderbuttons?gameId=1303]Button's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39656]Framework For Emote Mods[/url], or this mod won't work.
This mod does nothing on its own, but other mods can use ﻿it to add these custom emotes for use in events!


[size=4][b]For mod makers that wish to utilize this pack:
[/b][/size]Hey!! Super happy that my emote mod caught your eye :) 
I would appreciate a DM when you release your stuffs cause I wanna see your work but it's not required <3
Buttons has detailed documentation on [url=https://stardew.button.gay/docs/fem#:~:text=played%20in%20reverse.-,Every,-emote%20added%20to]use of custom emotes[/url]﻿, but afaik use of custom emotes is the exact same as use of normal emotes.
If you want to use for edit the assets directly, see below.



[b]For people who wish to use/edit the assets in my mod:
[/b][size=3][b]Mod edits:[/b][/size]
If you’re editing/updating/modifying my mod with the intent of publishing it in any way, message me here on Nexus for my permission before posting. If I don’t respond after 3 weeks, AND the content abides to all the rules listed below, you can post it anyways. Either way, please credit me in the post, abide by the rules below and provide a link to this mod page. I reserve the right to take your mod down if it violates the rules.

[size=3][b]Mod asset usage:
[/b][/size]If you wanna use my mod's art assets, please reach out to me.
All code is free for the yoinking, no credit needed.
Tinkering with my assets for personal use without intent to publish is perfectly fine with no permission :)

[size=3]Rules:
[/size]None of the following can be in your content: 
- Discrimination or bigotry of any sort. I don’t want my content to be associated with that.
- AI generated content
